thread:
Priya: Quick heads-up — PR #11177 modifies the routing layer and the cache invalidation path. We can't merge without an architecture decision note / RFC pointer. @arch-team can someone take this? RFC draft here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARCH/pages/987654321/kv-affinity-decision
Ant: Skimmed the diff — looks compact but this touches shard leader selection. I'm fine with the change only if there's a clear rollback and perf data for 8k token flows. Can you attach microbench results?
Priya: Uploaded a short perf gist and a rollback helper to the PR description: https://gist.github.com/priya/5a1b2c3 — main numbers: p50 latency +6ms, p95 +12ms on our 8k test. Rollback command in the gist.
Sam: FYI release window is tomorrow 10:00 PT. If arch signoff doesn't land today we'll need to reschedule the merge.
Leah: I can take a look after lunch. Quick question: does this change the KV cache key format or wire protocol? If so we need a migration note.
Priya: No key format changes — purely routing and invalidation. I added a compatibility note in the draft and a tiny shim option in the PR to preserve old behavior. Snippet we added to PR body:
```
# rollback helper
./scripts/rollback.sh --pr 11177 --fast
```
Leah: Thanks. I'll review the RFC draft and the perf numbers. If nothing unexpected shows up I'll post a short arch note and +1. @Priya please ping me on the RFC page once you tag it as "final" so I don't miss it.
Priya: Done — tagged the page and added the checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
